notes: Left 4 Dead 2 standard workshop audio isolation, sound.cache purge, and robust Future Rot top HUD release: eliminated all sound.cache bundling from addons/runetify.vpk, perfectly matching standard Steam Workshop mod architecture so the engine mounts raw audio streams without corrupting or overriding the master vanilla sound.cache; completely eliminated audio stutter, looping glitches, and frame drops; resolved top HUD font sizing by adjusting tall to 10 for clean, compact proportions; patched FutureRot.ttf and Futurot.vfont with full glyph coverage (including vertical pipe '|', hyphen, plus, slash, underscore, and space) eliminating all missing-character box glyphs; enabled dual .vfont and .ttf loading in CustomFontFiles; and published updated signed mod packages v0.2.223.
